exora.workshop.proof.1: Frame assembled • Hand Press plans unlocked
exora.workshop.proof.2: Drive fitted • Starter Generator and Coil Mill plans unlocked
exora.workshop.proof.3: Workshop commissioned • Electrical unlocked! Your bench can now build an Energy Buffer.
exora.workshop.objective.0: Keep a Stone Mallet in your pack. Assemble a Timber Frame from two planks and two sticks here to open the Hand Press plans.
exora.workshop.objective.1: Build a Hand Press. Press plates and shafts, assemble a drive at the bench, then fit it at the press. The geared press opens the power plans.
exora.workshop.objective.2: Touch the Starter Generator to the Coil Mill. Fuel it with charcoal, feed the mill one Copper Winding and take the Wound Cores to open Electrical.
exora.workshop.objective.3: Electrical is open. Build an Energy Buffer with two Wound Cores. Charge it beside the generator, then separate the generator and run the mill on the buffer.
exora.workshop.batch_hint: Press four batches in one stroke. Uses four times the materials.
exora.workshop.reopen: Workshop plans changed. Open the station again.
exora.meter.tooltip: Use on a power port. Read it twice to measure the change.
exora.workshop.hint.shop_lanterns: Hang over the work floor to light your shop.
exora.workshop.hint.feed_chute: Feed stock from above. Pull finished batches from below after commissioning.
exora.workshop.hint.line_meter: Read a generator, mill or buffer twice to measure the change in stored energy.
exora.workshop.hint.starter_generator: Smelt logs into charcoal. Fuel the generator and place the mill against any face.
exora.workshop.hint.coil_mill: Start with a Copper Winding. Take the Wound Cores by hand for commissioning.
exora.workshop.hint.energy_buffer: Charge beside the generator. Leave the buffer touching the mill and remove the generator.
exora.workshop.hint.hand_press: Place the press and open it to choose plates or shafts.
exora.station.recipes_hint: Browse milling recipes. Turn past the last plan to see operation tips again.
exora.station.idle_hint: Load a copper winding for your first cores. Open Recipes for more jobs.
exora.station.running_hint: The motor is drawing power. Collect the finished batch from the tray.
exora.station.no_power_hint: Fuel an adjoining generator or connect a charged buffer. The workpiece stays in the mill.
exora.station.blocked_hint: Take the finished batch from the tray to release the next workpiece.
exora.station.ready_hint: Take the output from the tray. Collect generator-made Wound Cores here to commission the shop.
exora.station.unrecognized_hint: Remove this feed and open Recipes to find stock the mill accepts.
exora.station.burning_hint: Charge flows to touching machines. One charcoal supplies 2,560 FE.
exora.station.governed_hint: Internal storage is full. Add a touching mill or buffer to draw power and resume.
exora.station.out_hint: Load charcoal made by smelting logs. Place a mill or buffer against any face.
exora.station.buffer_hint: Charge beside a generator. Mine the buffer with a pickaxe and place it beside a mill to run on stored power.
